results.criterion: The single HTML file contains separate, linked sections for Menu, Hours, Location, Pre-order, Gallery and Farm stories
results.note: Nav and DOM contain only #menu and #preorder; no Hours, Location, Gallery or Farm stories sections exist.

results.criterion: The Menu section lists items in categories, with each price shown or marked as a placeholder
results.note: MENU has 3 categories (Coffee, Tea and other drinks, Food), 8 items, all price:null rendered as 'Price placeholder'.

results.criterion: The Hours section lists opening times for every day of the week, or marked placeholders
results.note: No Hours section or day listing anywhere in the HTML.

results.criterion: The Location section shows the cafe name, an Indiranagar, Bengaluru address (or marked placeholder) and an embedded or linked map
results.note: No Location section, address placeholder or map; footer only has the text 'Brew Lab, Indiranagar, Bengaluru'.

results.criterion: The Pre-order section has a form where a visitor picks menu items and quantities, enters name, phone number and pickup time, and sees an order summary with a total before submitting
results.note: Form has qty steppers per item, name/tel/time inputs, live #sumList and #sumTotal above submit; validation present; no payment collected; forms=1, js_errors=[].

results.criterion: The Gallery section holds at least 12 image slots with alt text, lazy loading, and a way to view each image larger
results.note: No Gallery section and no img elements in the file.

results.criterion: The Farm stories section has three separate entries, one per coffee farm, each with a heading, a multi-paragraph story area, and image slots, with farm names and facts as marked placeholders where unknown
results.note: No Farm stories section or farm content in the file.

results.criterion: The page is responsive: it has a viewport meta tag and CSS rules that adapt the layout for narrow screens
results.note: Viewport meta present; @media (max-width:480px) and (min-width:700px) rules; mechanical check shows 0px overflow at 360px and 1280px.

results.criterion: The file needs no build step and loads any external library only from a CDN
results.note: Single 12,814 byte file, external_resources=[], one inline script and style.

results.criterion: Every unsupplied fact is visibly marked as a placeholder in the page
results.note: Prices, tagline, lead time, payment and order delivery are marked; item names like 'Coffee item 1' are covered by a section note only, and the phone input hint 'e.g. 98450 00000' looks like a real number. Cannot be fully passed while four sections are absent.

extra_issues.criterion: Charter rule: keep both gallery and farm stories, low cost, budget 35
extra_issues.note: State shows spent 30 of 35 with 5 remaining and no registered workflow for the missing sections; Adaptation and Priority cite roughly 70 for full scope (their figures, not re-priced by Audit).
